{{Top}}
A '''tsunami''' was a massive series of waves caused by a displacement of a large body of water. An [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] caused a thousand-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] tsunami that destroyed [[Newest Coast Town]], a colony on [[Ennth]].
